task_description: Clone a git repository from a URL.
Commit staged changes with a message given by the user.
Search a directory for files whose content matches a pattern.
Create a new system user with a given name.
Show one system report chosen by name: disk, memory or uptime.
Show the last lines of a log file chosen by the caller.
Build a list of command-line flags from a settings dictionary.
Resize a video to a given width in pixels with ffmpeg.
Return the open network connections for a given port number.
Install a package by name with the package manager.
